text: Santiago's having a housewarming sometime next month, once the kitchen's finished. Said he'd send a date. His partner Esther is doing the food.
farid mum in hospital again, hip. he's back and forth to leicester most weekends. ring him end of the week

Kalani invited us to her 40th, Saturday 14 November 2026, at the boathouse. Need to RSVP by the end of the month. Her husband Wiremu is doing a slideshow and wants old photos, so I should dig some out from the uni years. She thinks it's just drinks, it isn't, there's a band. Her sister is flying in from Auckland for it as a surprise too.

So Nikhil was saying his brother Sunil is finally moving back from Dubai, probably in the spring, and he's going to stay with Nikhil and his wife till he finds a place. Nikhil seemed a bit stressed about it honestly, their flat's tiny.
Kai dinner thing is off, his girlfriend broke her ankle. They'll rearrange after Christmas.
Alana - vegetarian now, not vegan. Loves anything with halloumi.
pick up dry cleaning, renew car tax before 1st nov
Ava said her daughter's christening is early March 2027, they're still sorting the church. We're invited. Find out if Graham wants to come too.
Emily and Finn are getting married!! Engaged last weekend in Lisbon. Wedding probably summer 2027. Don't forget to send them a card.

Graham's retiring at Christmas after 31 years at the council. His wife Krisztina is planning a do for him sometime in January, probably a Saturday mid-month, at the golf club. She asked me to help with the guest list and to track down his old boss. Graham's been a bit flat about it all, says he doesn't know what he'll do with himself. Fishing, apparently, and the grandkids.
Esther nervous about her driving test, it's sometime next week, she wouldn't say which day. Text her good luck Monday just in case.
Wiremu's son Reggie starts at Otago uni in February. Wiremu sounds a bit lost about it tbh.
called hadiza back. her dad's operation went fine, he's home and grumpy, which she says is a good sign. check how he's doing in a week or two
Dimitri - works nights at the depot now, so text don't call before 2pm. Has a greyhound called Pickle.
Tanvi had her baby! Little girl, born Thursday. She and Duc are exhausted but over the moon. Must sort a present, maybe something from that shop she likes in Bath.
Farah's sister Zara has her viva on 3 December 2026. Farah's flying over to be there. Ask Farah how it went after.
Ibrahim is hosting Eid dinner again next year and wants us there. He mentioned it twice so I think he means it.
Luis keeps talking about getting into sea swimming. Has been eyeing up one of those changing robes, could be a good birthday present, his birthday's in early March.

Notes from the Banerjee party: Stefan's now at Arup, structural engineer, moved to Bristol in the summer. Hiroshi Suzuki is his old flatmate, the one who does the ceramics. Oisín was there with his new girlfriend, didn't catch her name.
Remind me to call Uncle Graham about Gran's 90th. Family thinking a lunch sometime around Easter but nobody's booked anything.
Gabriel had his interview with the BBC yesterday. Says it went okay but he always says that. Results by end of the week apparently.
Kiri got into the choir!
Eduardo and his wife are having a leaving party before they move to Porto. Some time in late November, at their place. I'm bringing the dessert.

Zofia is really struggling at the moment. Her mum's dementia is getting worse and her brother isn't helping at all. She's thinking of going part time from January to look after her. Need to check in with her properly, maybe take her out for lunch next week.
Nikhil's kids, Kai and Ava, both mad about dinosaurs. Kai is 6, Ava 4.
Booked the vet for Saturday. Buy more cat food on the way home.
Kai said his dad's 70th is on 22 November 2026 and they're doing a big meal in Bath. Kai's organising it and he's panicking about the seating plan.
Duc - allergic to shellfish, don't do prawns again. Oops.

Just off the phone with Alana. Right, so her mum's moving in with them sometime after Christmas, which is a big change, and her husband Kai is not entirely thrilled. She's also got the work Christmas party on the 12th and doesn't want to go. And she mentioned her son Finn has his mocks in January and is barely revising. Lots going on. I should send her something nice this week, or at least drop round with wine.
Farid & his wife's anniversary 9 Dec. 10 yrs. They're going to Rome for it
Krisztina asked if I fancied coming to her book club's Christmas dinner, 5 December. Said yes. She's hosting at hers.

Hiroshi is going back to Osaka for a few months in the new year to be with his dad, who's not well. He's leaving mid-January probably, back sometime in April or May depending on how things go. His wife Kiri and their son are staying here because of school. He seemed pretty worn out by the whole thing. Don't forget to message him before he goes, and maybe offer Kiri a hand with lifts.
Stefan mentioned his partner Gabriel wants a record player, keeps sending him links. Christmas idea for both of us to chip in on?
esther's housewarming saturday 7th. bring plant. her bf santi does the bbq apparently
How did Ava's scan go? It was meant to be last Tuesday. Haven't heard anything. Text her.

Wiremu's daughter Kiri is in a play at school, the end of term show, sometime mid-December. She's got the lead, Wiremu is so proud he showed me three videos of rehearsals. She gets stage fright though, apparently threw up before the last one. Wants us to come if we can. Check the date with him nearer the time and send her a good luck card.
Ibrahim Osei — new neighbour at no 12. Teacher, two kids, dog called Biscuit. Wife's name is Hadiza I think.
Sunil's sister-in-law passed away last week. Funeral's Friday. Send a card to him and his brother.
Farah said her husband Dimitri is up for promotion, decision sometime in the spring. She's more nervous than he is.
Gym at 7 tomorrow, then food shop. Sunday batch cook.

Okay voice note. Luis invited me to his engagement party, it's 20 March 2027 so loads of time, but I need to book the train early because it's in Edinburgh. Also his fiancée Zara is gluten free, so if I'm bringing anything, keep that in mind.
Emily's off to Vietnam over the summer with her brother Oisín, a month backpacking. Ask her about it when she's back.
Tanvi's partner Duc lost his job, redundancy. She's putting a brave face on. Check in with her sometime next week.
Graham Walsh, Krisztina's dad. Ex-RAF. Loves cricket and military history. Hates being called Gray.
Need to get Kalani a present before Saturday. She hinted at those nice candles from Liberty.
santiago reckons he and esther will go to colombia in the spring to see his family. first time she'll meet his grandma
Zofia's daughter is starting nursery after half term. Zofia's dreading it more than the kid is.
Coffee with Reggie. He's applying for the MA at Goldsmiths, deadline end of January. Wants me to read his personal statement. Must do that this weekend.
Oisín's band has a gig on 28 November 2026 at the Lexington. He's really nervous, first proper headline. I'm going with Stefan.

Dinner at Farid and Farah's last night. Lovely. They have a new rescue cat, Pistachio, who hid all evening. Farah's mum lives with them now, she cooked most of it and kept refilling my plate. Farid's training for the Valencia marathon on 6 December 2026, first one, and is slightly obsessed. Farah wants a weekend away just the two of them sometime in the new year. They want to come to ours next, maybe end of November.
Kalani Santos aka Kal - met her at Esther's thing. Works in marketing at a charity, keen climber.
Alana's brother is getting married next spring and she's maid of honour, sorry, bridesmaid. Hen do is early March somewhere in Spain.
Don't forget: Hadiza's party at 8 on Saturday, it's her husband Luis's 50th, and they've asked for no presents but maybe a bottle anyway.
Nikhil couldn't make the barbecue after all, his son had a fever. Hope he's better. Message Nikhil tomorrow to see how the little one is.
Gabriel mentioned his mum's thinking of retiring sometime next year, she's been at the hospital forever.

Long chat with Eduardo after football. He finally told his parents about the move to Porto, they're upset but coming round. Moving date is end of November, so things are frantic. His wife Ava has already started her new job out there remotely and goes in to the office in the first week of December. He wants help shifting boxes on the weekend of the 21st. I said yes, obviously. Also he's giving away his bike, ask if Kiri still wants it.
Dimitri's driving test is next Thursday. Third attempt. He's dreading it. Remind me to text him the night before.
Stefan's wedding cancelled, they've split up. Really sad. He's moving out of their place sometime this month.
Ava's little boy Finn turns 5 on 15 January. Huge Paw Patrol fan.
Sunil invited me to Diwali at his parents' this year. Next Saturday. Ask him what to bring.
